summary.text: Kathy Rapp is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House District 65, covering Crawford, Forest and Warren counties, since December 2004 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is the Republican chairman of the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rapp attended Bryant-Stratton Business College and earned a paralegal certification from Slippery Rock University, according to Ballotpedia.

Before her election in November 2004 she worked as a community relations representative with Beverly Health Care, managing admissions and marketing for two facilities in Warren, and earlier worked in special education as a compliance monitor with the Pennsylvania Department of Education.
Rapp began her 11th term in January 2025, according to her official biography, and is serving her fourth full term as Republican chairman of the House Health Committee.
She also serves on the House Energy Committee and is Republican co-chairman of the bipartisan Pennsylvania House Pro-Life Caucus.
Her legislation to remove veterans' disability payments from income eligibility under the Property Tax/Rent Rebate Program became law in November 2016.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Destiny Howard as her opponent in the general election.
